products.name: Pitch AI
products.note: Presentation software AI; collaboration; template generation; EU-hosted

profile_text.body:
Pitch is a collaborative presentation platform designed for teams that want to create, share, and deliver presentations together. The company describes itself as "the AI presentation workspace" and positions its product around maintaining brand consistency at scale through shared templates, a brand library, and AI-assisted workflows.

The company's primary product, Pitch AI, falls within the slides and presentations category and offers features including AI-generated slides, collaboration tools, and a library of more than 150 fully customizable templates crafted by design experts. Users can start from a blank canvas, an existing template, or use AI to generate on-brand slides directly, and the platform also supports importing PPTX files. The product is EU-hosted, which the company notes as a feature of its infrastructure.

The held facts confirm Pitch has a tracked presence on theworldofai.org, with its profile verified as of August 2026. No litigation, MCP servers, SEC filings, or patent records are noted in the available data.
